name: Open EOR Country Employment & Cost Dataset
description: Statutory employer cost, minimum wage, leave, notice, severance and the full set of statutory employment terms for every country BestEOR.co has costed, each figure cited to a primary source.
employer_cost_pct_description: Representative comparison rate, not a salary-specific effective rate. Read the detail and note for caps, contribution bases and eligibility. Null means fixed local-currency amounts, not zero contributions.
